name: FrostByte
description: FrostByte develops cryogenic CMOS ASICs designed to control and read out quantum devices operating near absolute zero, addressing the wiring and control bottleneck that limits the scalability of large-scale quantum computers. The company was spun out of QuTech (TU Delft / TNO) in 2025.

products.name: Cryogenic CMOS ASICs
products.description: Application-specific integrated circuits for controlling and reading out quantum devices operating near absolute zero

highlights: Addresses the wiring bottleneck limiting scalability of large-scale quantum computers

news.title: FrostByte: Advancing European Quantum Sovereignty through Cryogenic Electronics
news.excerpt: FrostByte, spun out of TU Delft's QuTech institute in 2025, develops ultra-cold cryogenic electronics to overcome quantum computing's scaling challenges. The company's cryogenic CMOS chips operate reliably at temperatures near absolute zero, eliminating the wiring bottleneck that limits large-scale quantum processor development. The article discusses FrostByte's strategic significance for European quantum sovereignty and technological independence.
